title: First-principles investigation of thermoelectric performance in KMnZ (Z = Sn, Pb) half-Heusler alloys
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,4874-4891
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00220F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bharti Gurunani, Dinesh C. Gupta
DFT (WIEN2k) and DFPT were used to analyze KMnZ half-Heusler alloys. Spin-polarized phase II proved most stable, with LDA, PBE-GGA, and TB-mBJ confirming half-metallicity. The ductile, robust alloy shows promise for spintronics and thermoelectrics.
